name: smart-climate-trial-tweaks
goal: Per-zone live control for smart climate, main-floor Sleep seed 70, and a guest Sleep rule on the main floor.

userStories.title: Per-zone live gate
userStories.description: Seven climate_live_<zone> helpers, climate_live(zone) macro, every reader switched to it, seed turns all off, harness default loader, README. See prd.md decisions 1-6, 8.
acceptanceCriteria: Macro truth table tested (global/zone/unknown/missing; renders exactly True/False)
Apply: garage live with global off writes only the garage; others log dry run with zero climate calls
Apply: post-wait re-check uses the macro
Global on makes every zone live
Drift check: per-zone on triggers; tick acts only on live zones; start runs all
Dry-air (dry run) unless a radiant zone is live
Seed turns off global and all seven zone switches
Static test: no direct climate_live_ template/condition read outside the macro; global not on dashboards

userStories.title: Main-floor Sleep seed
userStories.description: Seed main-floor sleep heat 70 (from 72); README defaults.
acceptanceCriteria: Test asserts main-floor sleep heat seed 70 and second-floor 72

userStories.title: Guest Sleep rule
userStories.description: Main floor Sleep with guest_mode on uses Comfort (heat or cool), reason Guests; pre-wake wins. See decision 7.
acceptanceCriteria: Guest on Sleep Heating -> comfort heat, reason has Guests

userStories.title: Dashboard live toggles
userStories.description: Per-zone live toggles in the climate settings popup; Nest rows warn about the Eco clash; no global switch.
